warranty.title: Warranty
paragraphs: When you purchase any phone from our store, you get a full one-year warranty from a specialized service center.
We care about supplying quality products, so we strictly follow the Russian Government Resolution 'On approval of the Rules for the sale of certain types of goods...'.
Under the warranty terms, every customer may return a phone or hand it in for repair provided the factory seals are untouched. More detailed conditions are listed below.

Before dispatching every order we carefully inspect and test each device, so the chances of customers receiving a defective item are minimized. We do not allow devices with the slightest defect to be sold.
Enjoy your pleasant shopping!

accordion.title: Return and repair
accordion.text: Every customer may return a phone or hand it in for repair provided the factory seals are untouched. We resolve all warranty issues within 1–3 days after free diagnostics.

accordion.title: What the warranty does not cover
accordion.text: Mechanical damage, traces of liquid contact, and repairs outside an authorized service center are not warranty cases.

accordion.title: How to use the warranty
accordion.text: Call us or write in the chat, bring the device with the receipt, and we will run free diagnostics within 24 hours and resolve the issue.

returnPolicy.lead: Any device can be exchanged or returned within 14 days

sections.title: Return of goods of inadequate quality
paragraphs: If a customer has purchased a product of inadequate quality, they have the right to demand from the seller: free elimination of all defects or payment for repairs performed by another service center; a price reduction proportionate to the defect; replacement with an equivalent device, or a product of another model or brand taking into account the difference in price.
It should be noted that such customer requirements for expensive and complex goods may be satisfied only if the defects are significant.
The customer may refuse repair, price reduction and replacement by returning the defective product and receiving back the full amount paid for it.

If defects caused any losses, the customer has the right to demand compensation. In this case the Law 'On Protection of Consumer Rights' must be followed and compensation must be made within the statutory time limits.
If the seller refuses to hand over the goods, the customer may demand compensation for losses. The seller must return the full price of the goods within 10 days of receiving written claims.
If the customer has no documents confirming the purchase, this does not deprive them of the right to prove the sale transaction by any legal means.

If defects are found in a technically complex expensive product, the customer is entitled to withdraw from the purchase or demand replacement with an equivalent device. When replacing with a device of another brand or model, the price must be recalculated. Such a transaction can be made within fifteen days, but the seller must first receive the goods for inspection and confirmation of the defects.
The full list of technically complex goods can be found in the relevant Russian Government Resolution No. 924.
If a gift was included with the product, the customer must return it as well when returning a defective product, keeping it in marketable condition.

All inspections are carried out in accordance with legislation, within the statutory time limits, taking into account customer requirements and the warranty obligations of the seller or manufacturer. Only specialized accredited service centers may conduct an inspection. Without such an inspection the seller cannot confirm the defect, its causes, or justify the customer's claims, and therefore cannot be held responsible for delay until the product is handed over.

If the inspection establishes that the defects were caused by the customer's careless handling of the device, the customer is obliged to reimburse the costs of transportation and the expert examination.

sections.title: Return of goods of adequate quality
paragraphs: Returning a product of adequate quality is possible under certain conditions: the availability of documents confirming the purchase. If the relevant document is missing, the customer may make a return by proving the purchase by any other means.
If the device has individual features and is intended for use exclusively by a specific consumer, the customer cannot make a return.
If the customer refuses the purchase, the seller must reimburse the full amount paid, excluding transport costs. Review period in accordance with Article 22 — 10 days.
If a gift was included with the product, the customer must return it, keeping it in marketable condition and properties.

When processing a return, the customer (or their representative) and the seller sign a document recording the transaction and containing the following information: the seller's name; the customer's full name; the product name; the date of the transaction; the amount the seller undertakes to refund.
